using namespace std;

double getProb(int x, int n) {
    double term1 = 3.0 / 2.0 * (double)x / n * (double)(n - x) / (n - 1) * (double)(n - x - 1) / (n - 2);
    double term2 = 3.0 * (double)x / n * (double)(x - 1) / (n - 1) * (double)(n - x) / (n - 2);
    double term3 = 1.0 * (double)x / n * (double)(x - 1) / (n - 1) * (double)(x - 2) / (n - 2);
    return term1 + term2 + term3;
}

    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    double p;
    cin >> n >> p;
